Result.source: Question scores follow a table built on the 2025 national travel and inbound visitor surveys (Korea Tourism Data Lab); place shares are counted from the app's place categories

C1.name: Trend Seeker
C1.description: You like hunting down trending neighborhoods and cafés with friends and keeping busy well into the night.

C2.name: Romantic Duo
C2.description: Scenic viewpoints, city lights, and a great meal make your perfect day together.

C3.name: Family Adventurer
C3.description: Activities the kids can dive into, beaches, and camping suit your trips best.

C4.name: Active Explorer
C4.tagline: Walk, look, and take it all in
C4.description: Walking through nature and taking your time at historic places suits you best.

C5.name: Solo Recharger
C5.tagline: A quiet break on your own
C5.description: Walking and resting at your own pace, somewhere green and uncrowded, suits you best.

C6.name: Local Foodie
C6.description: Old-school eateries and markets where you can taste the region suit you best.

C7.name: K-Culture Explorer
C7.description: Filming locations, live shows, and shopping — getting close to Korean pop culture suits you best.

C8.name: Wellness Traveler
C8.description: Beauty and spa time, shopping, and good food at an easy pace suit you best.

C9.name: Nature Wanderer
C9.tagline: Out of the city, into nature
C9.description: Taking your time in regions known for their landscapes, like Jeju, suits you best.

C10.name: Heritage Explorer
C10.description: Palaces, museums, and regional cities where tradition is still alive suit you best.

info.title: Travel info
info.hubPick: Choose a city to see its gateway
info.tips: Set your dates, starting point and times in the Course tab, and the places you've added are split into a day-by-day route with arrival, departure and travel times for each stop. Apart from your own car, long-distance transport only offers modes found at both your starting point and the destination's gateway, so Jeju is reached by flight or ferry. The last day ends at your departure time from the destination, and booking links for KTX, SRT, buses, rental cars and stays are at the bottom of the Course tab.
